hero.headline: AI Automation Engineer & Full Stack Developer
hero.subheadline: I build web apps and AI automations that real businesses use every day — from WhatsApp platforms to AI sales agents. Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, n8n and LLMs. Trained at Forward Costa Rica. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site roles.

items.role: Freelance Full Stack & AI Automation Developer
items.description: Build and maintain production systems for clients: a WhatsApp switchboard and an AI diagnostics app for a YouTube agency, AI receptionists for clinics, an AI sales agent for an online store and B2B prospecting automation.

Built AI automations and system integrations (LLM APIs, CRMs, email and custom REST APIs) for clients of an AI automation agency, and supported backend and frontend development of client web applications, APIs and internal tools.

projects.title: Projects

items.title: Juny Relay
items.note: Client project · In daily use · Code private
items.description: WhatsApp switchboard for a video-editing agency: editors and clients collaborate in real time through one agency number, while the client's phone, name and photo stay hidden from editors to prevent client poaching. Encrypted storage (AES-256, HMAC-hashed phones), row-level security, a real-time admin panel and an external watchdog that alerts when messages stop flowing.

items.title: AI YouTube Channel Diagnostics
items.note: Client project · In production · Code private
items.description: Internal tool for a YouTube growth agency: paste a channel and get a first-draft diagnosis built from real channel data, including thumbnail analysis with vision, a ready-to-send message for the creator, report history and feedback ratings. About USD 0.002 per report.

items.title: Aroma Noir — AI Sales Assistant
items.description: Perfume store with an AI sales agent on Instagram that advises customers, sends product photos, checks stock, creates orders, reads payment receipts and sends automatic follow-ups within Instagram's 24-hour window. Includes a Next.js storefront and an orders dashboard.

items.title: B2B Email Prospecting System
items.description: End-to-end cold-email prospecting for agencies that sell to YouTube channels: lead scraping and enrichment (430+ leads in the first run), automated follow-up sequences and a metrics dashboard. Later adapted to serve several clients with shared contact rules.

items.title: AI Receptionist for Dental Clinics
items.description: Virtual receptionist ("Sofia") that books appointments, follows up with patients and transcribes voice notes over WhatsApp, with human handoff in Chatwoot. Paired with Increase Clinic, a small-clinic CRM.

items.title: Alumni Platform
items.description: Platform for an independent alumni foundation that supports UCR students. Three roles (student, alumni, admin), server-side auth enforcing Row Level Security, magic-link login and an AI tool that adapts CVs for ATS in real time with Claude.

items.title: Chamos House
items.description: Restaurant management system with real-time order handling and a WhatsApp chatbot ("Chamo, ordena") that takes orders in natural language through n8n. Includes a live kitchen display over WebSockets and a sales dashboard.

items.title: Ashley — Clothing Catalog
items.description: Fast catalog for a sportswear seller: 722 models, 1,243 color variants and 4,772 photos with filters, search, a color picker and a WhatsApp button that opens the chat with the product already written.

Focused on practical AI integration for businesses: automation pipelines, LLM APIs, chatbot development, and B2B and B2C use cases.

about.title: About
about.text: I'm a Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Engineer based in Costa Rica, trained through Forward Costa Rica's Full Stack Development and AI Solutions for Business programs. I work across product and infrastructure: I build the UI, design the API and database, connect LLMs to real workflows and deploy the stack. My systems run in production for real clients, and I use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) daily while reviewing every line they produce. Open to full stack, AI integration and automation roles — remote, hybrid or on-site. Spanish (native) · English (B2).
